Subject: RE: MSA and order form for renewal 2028

Thanks for the tag, Mark.

I reviewed APD_Counter_MSAv3 and prepared a focused redline that preserves the commercial economics but narrows the open legal items. Attached is MSA_v3_redlines.pdf with inline notes. High level summary of our changes:

1) Data residency
- We accept US-only residency for production customer data. Added language that allows ephemeral logs to be processed in other regions for maintenance with customer notice.

2) SLA and sustained throughput
- Tightened SLA definition to cover latency and availability. Added a capacity Surge Clause that describes a best-effort approach for sustained throughput above the committed level. For guaranteed capacity increases we require a 14 day notice window and a temporary reservation fee.

3) Term and renewal mechanics
- Converted automatic renewal to auto-renew unless either party gives 60 days notice. Added a carve out allowing contract amendment for pricing if capacity commitments change by more than 30%.

4) Indemnity and limitation edits
- Kept liability cap at 2x MRR but added an exception for gross negligence and willful misconduct per our standard playbook.

Open items needing APD confirmation:
- Acceptance of Surge Clause wording or whether they want a firm SLA for burst throughput (commercial implication: higher unit price)
- Whether APD requires all audit logs to be US-only or accepts summarized audit exports for legal review

Attachments: MSA_v3_redlines.pdf (pdf - comments)

If APD can confirm the Surge Clause and residency approach by tomorrow EOD, we can finalize and send to DocuSign by Friday.

Lauren Bishop
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
From: Jamie Torres <jamie.torres@apollodiagnostics.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com, markus.klein@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@apollodiagnostics.com
Date: Thu, 2 Aug 2028 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA and order form for renewal 2028

Hi Lauren — thanks for the detailed redline, that helps a lot. A few quick answers from procurement:

- Surge Clause: We prefer a firm SLA for bursts up to 48 hours at the committed uplift level. If there is a price delta, please propose it so we can evaluate.
- Audit logs: We can accept summarized audit exports for legal review, but the production logs for regulatory investigations must be retained in US-only for seven years.

We also have a short procurement questionnaire attached that our internal compliance team will use as part of the approval gate. If you can populate the tech sections and return, we can expedite approvals.

Attachments: Procurement_Questions.xlsx (xlsx)

Best,
Jamie
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jamie Torres <jamie.torres@apollodiagnostics.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com, monica_patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, 4 Aug 2028 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA and order form for renewal 2028

Jamie — appreciate the quick turnaround. Short answers and plan: 

1) Surge SLA: Legal and SE agree to propose a bounded burst SLA for up to 48 hours at the uplift level. Monica will send a short pricing delta for that SLA by Monday. If APD agrees, we will incorporate it into the order form as an optional addendum.

2) Audit logs: We accept the 7 year US-only retention requirement for production logs. Operational note: logs will be stored in APD's dedicated VPC region and access governed by KMS/HSM keys controlled by APD. Lauren, can you confirm the exact language to add to section 6.2?

3) Procurement questionnaire: Monica will take the technical sections and return a filled copy in the morning.

Commercial concession: to support the capacity ramp we will provide a one-time 10% credit on the first month invoice for the increased capacity. This is contingent on signing the finalized MSA + order form by EOD Friday (2028-08-10).

Next steps:
- Monica: deliver pricing delta and completed questionnaire (Mon)
- Lauren: finalize Section 6.2 language and provide final PDF for DocuSign (Tue)
- APD: confirm acceptance of Surge SLA and 7-year log retention (Tue)

If we get confirmations on Tuesday, we will create the DocuSign envelope and aim to be fully executed by Friday, 2028-08-10.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
